sentences.text: Mr Chairman, I beg to move, "That the total sum to be allocated for Head X of the Estimates be reduced by $100." Before I begin, let me wish all the ladies here "Happy Women's Day".

sections.label: MCCY and citizen involvement
sections.summary: MCCY has been leading efforts to ensure citizens are actively involved in nation-building and policy deliberation and design.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth (MCCY) has been taking the lead in ensuring that citizens are actively involved in our nation-building, in policy deliberation and design.

sections.label: MUIS support and M3 collaboration
sections.summary: The passage asks for an update on MUIS support for Madrasah Wak Tanjong and notes Minister Masagos Zulkifli's remarks on M3 collaboration.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: (In Malay):   Chairman, during last year's Committee of Supply (COS), it was announced that the Islamic Religious Council of Singapore (MUIS) would be providing a Comprehensive Assistance Package to Madrasah Wak Tanjong.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Could the Minister provide an update on MUIS' support for Madrasah Wak Tanjong so that the madrasah will continue to be an apex institution that produces religious scholars and leaders for the community?

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: (In Malay):   	Sir, during a media interview in July 2018, Minister Masagos Zulkifli spoke about the collaboration between three key agencies ‒ the Council for the Development of the Singapore Malay/Muslim Community (MENDAKI), MUIS, and the People’s Association Malay Activity Executive Committees Council (MESRA) ‒ known as M3, as an initiative to further strengthen and uplift the Malay/Muslim community in Singapore.

sections.label: M3 joint office and Tiga M
sections.summary: A joint M3 office was launched in Wisma Geylang Serai, and the passage asks whether M3 will expand programmes beyond the projected 350 families.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: (In Malay):   	In January this year, I was heartened to note that a joint office for M³, consisting of MENDAKI, MUIS and MESRA, was launched in Wisma Geylang Serai.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Even before they came together under this joint office, the three organisations already began their first collaboration in September last year, where they rolled out an enhanced version of MENDAKI's Tiga M Programme, which helps participants improve their Mathematics skills and creativity as well as strengthen family bonds.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Will M3 expand its programmes so that even more can benefit beyond the projected 350 families?

sentences.text: (In Malay):   With over 4,000 asatizahs now registered under the Asatizah Recognition Scheme, it is hoped that they will bring a more visible positive impact to the community.

sections.label: Enhancing asatizahs' knowledge capabilities
sections.summary: Asatizahs' functioning capabilities and breadth of knowledge need enhancing amid newer issues like global Islamophobia and terrorism.

sentences.text: (In English): We need to enhance our asatizahs' functioning capabilities, breadth and spectrum of knowledge in this ever-disruptive world, especially with newer issues and challenges cropping up every so often, for example, global Islamophobia, terrorism and its unfortunate link to the religion and so on.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: However, professional skills and qualifications are requirements in social work.

sections.label: Education and lifelong learning
sections.summary: A question asks how community organisations such as MENDAKI support children in valuing knowledge and self-directed lifelong learning.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: (In Malay):   	Education is a critical aspect in social mobility, as it opens doors to educational and career opportunities.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Our children should not learn only for the sake of exams, but they must appreciate the purpose of self-development and self-mastery throughout life.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: To maximise the odds that our children would succeed in life, they must grow to appreciate the value of intellectual curiosity, adaptability and self-motivation.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: These foundational mindsets need to be imbued from a young age so that it becomes second nature.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Could the Minister share on how our community organisations, such as MENDAKI, are supporting our children in inculcating an understanding of the importance of knowledge and the value of self-directed lifelong learning?

sections.label: M3 ground organisation

sentences.speaker: The Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We have also launched pilots to make M3 felt on the ground, starting in Tampines and Pasir Ris-Punggol.

sections.label: Postgraduate Certificate for Asatizah
sections.summary: The Postgraduate Certificate in Islam in Contemporary Societies will be rolled out in 2020 for returning religious graduates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Second, in line with the vision of "Asatizah of the Future" we will roll out the Postgraduate Certificate in Islam in Contemporary Societies (PCICS) for all returning religious graduates in 2020.

sections.label: Madrasah programmes and assistance
sections.summary: 26 students began the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme at Madrasah Aljunied, and MUIS worked with Madrasah Wak Tanjong on a Comprehensive Assistance Package.

sentences.speaker: The Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: In support of this vision, I am pleased to update that the first batch of 26 students under the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme has begun their studies in Madrasah Aljunied.

sentences.speaker: The Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: This programme aims to develop future asatizahs with a broad set of knowledge and skills to guide the community.

sentences.speaker: The Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: In addition, MUIS has worked closely with Madrasah Wak Tanjong on a Comprehensive Assistance Package to strengthen its administration and education programmes with a new management board who will be able to contribute multiple perspectives to guide the madrasah.

sections.label: M3 networks and resources

sentences.speaker: The Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: It’s the least I can do, especially if one has the know-how to help others.” Each of us can set this circle of excellence into motion if we work together for a common cause, if we encourage others to persevere, and if we help the next generation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: And M3 will provide the networks and resources to leverage the rich relationships and expertise in our community.

sections.label: MUIS support for asatizahs
sections.summary: MUIS is increasing its support for asatizahs in three ways along their journey.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs and Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: To address all these, MUIS is increasing its support for our asatizahs through their journey from being students to asatizahs in three ways.

sections.label: MUIS Student Liaison Officers
sections.summary: MUIS has SLOs in Cairo, Jeddah and Singapore supporting Singaporean students in the Middle East, North Africa and Southeast Asia.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs and Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: MUIS has deployed one SLO based in Cairo and another one in Jeddah and they are supporting over 500 Singaporean students in the Middle East and North Africa.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs and Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: Another SLO based in Singapore is supporting about 300 of our students in Southeast Asia.

sections.label: ICON and PCICS programmes
sections.summary: Since 2017 overseas Islamic college graduates must attend the ICON programme before ARS accreditation, and MUIS will introduce the one-year PCICS programme in 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs and Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: Since 2017, graduates from overseas Islamic colleges have had to attend a compulsory four-week programme organised by the MUIS Academy, titled “Islam in Context” (ICON) Certificate, before they can be accredited under the ARS.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs and Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: This acknowledges that our asatizahs today serve in many domains beyond the religious sector, including counselling and consultancy services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs and Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: Thus, starting in 2020, MUIS will introduce the one-year PCICS programme for returning graduates.

sections.label: Purpose of COFA
sections.summary: COFA was formed to understand the community's evolving needs, react to trends and hear ground-up feedback on preparing future asatizahs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs and Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: COFA was formed to help us gain a better understanding of the evolving needs of the community, react to the trends that will shape the community's future, and hear ground-up feedback on how we can prepare our next generation of asatizahs.

sections.label: COFA public engagement
sections.summary: Over the next few months COFA members will engage the public and gather feedback from religious students, parents, employers, asatizahs and the wider community.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs and Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: Over the course of the next few months, members of COFA will engage the public and gather feedback from key stakeholders like our religious students and their parents, employers, the asatizah fraternity and the wider community.

sections.label: Three COFA key plans
sections.summary: Through COFA three plans will be developed on training asatizahs, facilitating employment of religious graduates and retaining religious sector leaders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs and Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: Through COFA, we will be able to work more closely with the community to develop three key plans.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs and Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: First, producing asatizahs who are trained to meet the evolving needs of the Singapore Muslim community and contribute to the wider Singapore society; second, facilitating employment of our religious graduates in good jobs in the religious sector and beyond; and third, cultivating and retaining a strong pipeline of leaders for the religious sector.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Foreign Affairs and Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, today, we have over 4,000 asatizahs who play a critical role in guiding the Singapore Muslim community.

sections.label: MENDAKI preschool outreach
sections.summary: MENDAKI has been appointed by the Early Childhood Development Agency as a preschool outreach agency for Malay children aged four to six.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower and National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: To Ms Rahayu Mahzam’s question on strengthening preschool outreach and support, MENDAKI has been appointed by the Early Childhood Development Agency as a preschool outreach agency to reach out to Malay children aged between four and six not already enrolled in preschool.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower and National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: MENDAKI reached more than 2,000 parents and children through PlayFest and mini PlayFest in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower and National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: In particular, over 80% of children who attended Tiga M did not need to enrol in the Learning Support Programme for Mathematics at Primary 1.

sections.label: KMM@CC expansion to five locations
sections.summary: KMM@CC is expanding to five more locations, with classes starting in the first half of 2019 and benefiting more than 1,500 parents and children this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower and National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: Now that we have established a working model for M3 collaboration on the ground, we can scale up the programme so as to benefit parents and children.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower and National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: This year, we are expanding KMM@CC to five more locations – Admiralty, Boon Lay, Choa Chu Kang, Keat Hong and Woodlands.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower and National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: The classes will commence in the first half of 2019, and will benefit more than 1,500 parents and children this year.

sections.label: Empowerment Programmes and Anugerah MENDAKI review
sections.summary: MENDAKI will pilot Empowerment Programmes for Boys and Girls in the second quarter of 2019 for Malay/Muslim ITE students and has convened a committee to review the Anugerah MENDAKI award.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower and National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: I wish to assure Mr Amrin Amin that MENDAKI will pilot the Empowerment Programme for Boys and Empowerment Programme for Girls in the second quarter of 2019 for Malay/Muslim ITE students at MENDAKI's Youth Spaces at three ITE colleges.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower and National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: This mentoring programme will strengthen critical lifeskills, provide youths with advice on future education and career pathways.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower and National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: It will also introduce students to role models they can relate to and who will share on different pathways to success.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower and National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: Recognising the different pathways to success, MENDAKI has convened a committee to review the prestigious Anugerah MENDAKI award, which today honours Malay or Muslim students for their academic success.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower and National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: This committee comprises representatives from schools, madrasahs and Institutes of Higher Learning (IHLs), and seeks to ensure that the benchmarks for excellence remain relevant.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower and National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: With our renewed spirit of gotong royong, every new generation will be able to build on the successes of previous generations to reach higher and go further.

sections.label: Eight towns with most Malay residents

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: (In Malay):   	We chose these eight towns as these towns have the highest percentage of Malay residents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: This would ensure a high degree of effectiveness based on our available resources at this point in time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We will expand it to other areas later.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: Second, we are holding discussions with overseas universities on how we can collaborate to enhance the curriculum for PCICS students.

sections.label: Reviewing MENDAKI tuition schemes
sections.summary: MENDAKI's tuition schemes could be reviewed to see how they align with MOE's announced primary and secondary school changes, such as subject-based banding.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Among other things that we could potentially look at would be reviewing MENDAKI's tuition schemes to see how they align with the primary school and secondary school changes that were just announced by MOE, for example, for subject-based banding.

sections.label: MENDAKI satellite centres expansion
sections.summary: MENDAKI has eight satellite centres, launched MENDAKI@Choa Chu Kang and M3@WGS, and will conduct a needs analysis to add more satellite centres.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: (In Malay):   MENDAKI currently has eight satellite service centres.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Last September, we launched MENDAKI@Choa Chu Kang and we served 1,100 beneficiaries in six months.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Therefore, in January this year, MENDAKI and MUIS also launched a one-stop centre, M3@WGS, to further extend the reach of these two organisations to give them a presence in the neighbourhood areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: This office also acts as a hub to create community initiatives.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Hence, MENDAKI will conduct a needs analysis to add more satellite centres which will be based on the needs of the residents, and MENDAKI will continue to work with the M3 network to further expand and engage families in the neighbourhood areas.

sections.label: Inter-religious harmony and radicalisation risk
sections.summary: Radicalisation can occur through community contacts online or face-to-face, and an inter-religious organisation of 10 faiths has promoted harmony since 1949.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: But this is not something that we can take for granted because the seeds of discontent and the radicalisation of individuals can be carried out in the community through contacts online or face-to-face interaction.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: We have an inter-religious organisation where 10 different faiths come together, interact and engage with one another to promote inter-religious harmony in Singapore since its founding 70 years ago in 1949.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat

sections.label: Grace Fu on volunteerism rate
sections.summary: A 2018 Straits Times article quoted Minister Grace Fu saying Singapore hopes to double volunteerism to 70% in five years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, in a 2018 June article from the Straits Times, Minister Grace Fu said that, "Singapore hopes to double its volunteerism rate from one in three currently to 70% in five years' time".

sections.label: Singapore volunteerism growth statistics
sections.summary: Volunteerism grew from 9% in 2000 to 35% in 2016, with volunteer hours doubling from 66 million to 121 million.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Currently, the rate of volunteerism in Singapore has grown from 9% in 2000 to 35% in 2016, with the total volunteer hours doubling from 66 million hours in 2014 to 121 million hours in 2016.

sections.label: Global volunteer work statistics
sections.summary: A 2011 Johns Hopkins study estimated about 140 million volunteers in 37 countries contributing $400 billion yearly.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: According to statistics from the Johns Hopkins Centre for Civil Society Studies in 2011, approximately 140 million people in the 37 countries engage in volunteer work in a typical year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: It is estimated that volunteers contribute around $400 billion to the global economy annually.

sections.label: SG Cares youth volunteering
sections.summary: The SG Cares platform matches individuals to volunteering opportunities, and youth participation rose 16-fold from 2009 to 2019, with youths nearly 80% of registered volunteers.

sections.label: Athletes' spexScholarship choice and campaign funding
sections.summary: Athletes' decisions on the spexScholarship are respected, and campaign funding, increased 50% this year, supports athletes not on the scholarship.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: And we respect athletes' own decisions whether or not to take up the spexScholarship and commit to the set of conditions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: I had shared earlier about the campaign funding which, this year, we have increased by 50%, to provide resources to athletes to train for the major games.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: These are athletes who are not on the spexScholarship.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: So, if someone turns down the spexScholarship and if the person is a potential to represent Singapore at major games, the support under campaign funding will be available to the NSA to send the athlete overseas for competition or for training so that the athlete or the NSA is not worse off.

sections.label: SportsSG support for potential athletes
sections.summary: SportsSG commits to providing resources, through spexScholarship or campaign funding, for athletes with potential who are willing to commit.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: SportsSG's commitment is that as long as the athlete has the potential and is willing to give the commitment, resources will be provided for, whether in the form of spexScholarship or campaign funding.

sections.label: Removing cash portion of spexScholarship
sections.summary: A suggestion is to remove the cash benefit portion of the spexScholarship while providing other benefits, including the overseas training grant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam
sentences.text: So, for them to take up the spexScholarship is a loss of income.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam
sentences.text: However, could there be a possibility to remove that portion, allow them to continue on their current income without the cash benefit portion, but provide the rest of the benefits of the spexScholarship, including the overseas training grant, so that both the NSA would benefit as well as the athlete himself or herself?

sections.label: Support for full-time athletes on payroll
sections.summary: For full-time athletes, the suggestion is to take out the cash portion and provide other benefits, with support worked out through STTA's plan.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam
sentences.text: So, it is not that they have another job that they have to give up on.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam
sentences.text: So, when the spexScholarship is offered to them, there is a difference between the quantum within the spexScholarship and their current income.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam
sentences.text: So, my suggestion is to take out that cash portion and to provide them with the other benefits if they are already full-time athletes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: In a case where the athlete is already receiving a full-time pay – as I gather – from STTA, there are also other spex grants, and also the multi-year sports plan that we can work out together to see how best to support them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: So, if STTA could put into its plan the support required for full-time players under its payroll, I am sure we can work out something.

sections.label: Mainstreaming athletes with disabilities

sentences.text: So, this is where, sometimes, when we say that we want to mainstream the athletes, we would like the NSAs to have them.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: But if they are not ready, if they do not have the coaches, if they do not have the training facilities because some of them do require special training facilities, then we may not be serving the interest of the athletes with disabilities.

sections.label: Funding as persuasion tool
sections.summary: NSAs can sometimes be persuaded by funding, but the speaker is realistic about how effective funding is as influence.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: While NSAs can be persuaded sometimes by funding, but we are also quite realistic about how effective funding can be used as a tool to influence.

sections.label: Mainstreaming athletes with disabilities caution
sections.summary: The speaker appreciates points on mainstreaming athletes with disabilities but urges patience so an organisation that has worked well is not dismantled.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We understand, we totally appreciate the points that Ms Denise Phua and Ms Yip Pin Xiu talked about, if I may use the word "mainstreaming" athletes with disabilities with able-bodied athletes.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: But in this process, I would just like to urge Members' patience and due consideration, so that we do not dismantle an organisation that has already worked for many years and has worked well for a long period of time.

sections.label: Sports embedded in NSAs

sentences.text: It is because we have the ability to bring options to him.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
